🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; the weak breadth and Technology’s -8.88% 1M return confirm a fragile backdrop, while strength in Communication and Utilities argues against a uniform selloff. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads (+3.36% 1W, +8.10% 1M): CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities (+1.22% 1W, +2.46% 1M) and Energy (+0.40% 1W, -6.51% 1M) follow; CEG (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.12%) RECOVERY, while Energy’s monthly trend remains weak.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary (-1.71% 1W), Consumer Staples (-1.27%), and Healthcare (-1.24%) are the weakest sectors. TJX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, and SYK (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +12.83%) CORRECTION show the pressure and mixed timeframes.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY; CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.12%) RECOVERY; VST (1W: +10.94% | 1M: -17.81%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors across the Top 5), though three of the five are short-term recoveries.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -25.86%) BELOW TREND; SRE (1W: -5.65% | 1M: -5.04%) BELOW TREND; TJX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +12.83%) CORRECTION; MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Technology, Utilities, Consumer Discretionary, and Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY, and CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is evident across several leaders and large-cap names; treat recoveries as tactical, not confirmed trend reversals.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak and internally mixed: sector return -0.04% 1W and -8.88% 1M across 24 stocks. NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND contrast with AAPL (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -17.05%) RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are down 0.97% 1W but up 4.79% 1M, pointing to a pullback rather than uniform monthly weakness. JPM (1W: -2.48% | 1M: +3.61%), V (1W: -2.34% | 1M: +7.64%), and MA (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +9.25%) are all in CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare fell 1.24% 1W but gained 9.66% 1M; recent performance is mixed against a positive monthly backdrop. JNJ (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +12.79%) and LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) are ABOVE TREND, while CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) is also ABOVE TREND.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Communication and Healthcare strength while keeping risk measured given CAUTION and 4/11 positive sectors; avoid treating Technology rebounds as established trend changes. Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND against AAPL (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND, if gains hold; LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) ABOVE TREND, with raised sales outlook as a catalyst. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND, if weakness persists; MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND, if selling continues.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+3.36% 1W; +8.10% 1M) and Utilities (+1.22% 1W; +2.46% 1M), the strongest of the four positive sectors. BEARISH: Technology (-0.04% 1W; -8.88% 1M) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.71% 1W; +10.18% 1M); overall breadth remains 4/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so no numeric support or resistance levels can be established. Watch for trend confirmation in AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -17.05%) RECOVERY; further weakness would leave NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND at risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+75): raised 2026 sales forecast; price action confirms the catalyst, with LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) ABOVE TREND. LRCX (+75): announced a $25 billion buyback after a sharp reported decline; LRCX (1W: +6.53% | 1M: -21.66%) RECOVERY, so price and monthly trend diverge from the positive news. GOOGL (+45): earnings reaffirmed broad-based strength; GOOGL (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -17.05%) RECOVERY, with follow-through still needed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-75): reported board turmoil and allegations; NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND, confirming the negative sentiment. Other negative headlines are not paired with return data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with 4/11 sectors positive; style mixed / no clear leadership, and narrow breadth calls for selectivity despite broad Top 5 sector representation. CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Monitor the major divergence in Technology and NVDA’s negative news confirmation: NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND.
